traces.level: L0 Edge GNN (EdgeLevelGNN, baseline_model.pt, upstream :4792; the only GNN still voting in the composite, weight 0.30 of 0.85)

components.name: l0_edge (asolaria-l0-edge)
components.role: aether's own Rust port. It has the HBP EVENT-row parser, extractNodeFeatures, Q24 input scaling, the served EdgeLevelGNN forward (PyG GCNConv x2 + edge head + exact sigmoid), the checkpoint weights quantized to Q24 consts, and observe_pair(events, actor, target) -> Option<Q24>

components.name: asolaria-observed
components.role: aether's own code. Takes the L0 reading, then builds the asolaria-score signals and the composite (l0 weight 30, g1/g2/g3 10, shannon 15, baseline 10; l4 reported but not weighted). Then reverse gain, forward_score_q/reverse_risk_q and FischerScore.l0_real, which go into a VerifiedEnvelope. observe_and_compose hands that envelope to gate/verdict

components.name: asolaria-verdict
components.role: aether's own code. Tighten-only Layer-5 compose over hookwall_pre, spawn_gate, tier_gate, Fischer and input_guard: the strictest severity wins, and an empty set gives Block

components.name: asolaria-hookwall spawn_gate
components.role: aether's own code. Score gate: PROCEED only if forward_score_q>=720 && reverse_risk_q<=280, otherwise HOLD

components.name: fischer-eval
components.role: Fischer gate. Reads only the presence bit l0_real (cpl -100, flag gnn_observable, center_gain +200). It does not read the L0 value

components.name: asolaria CLI
components.role: The only runtime entry. `asolaria observe --events <file>` parses EVENT rows and runs observe_and_compose, then prints a GATE row and exits 0/3/4. `asolaria gate` instead takes forward_score_q/reverse_risk_q/composite/l0_real from the caller

components.name: aether-loop hookwall pass library
components.role: Port of bigpickle asolaria-hookwall.mjs: GateLanes trait (SCORE + Fischer lanes), pass/pass_chain, decide_verdict (FARM_GEM/BLOCK_AND_PRESERVE/OBSERVE_ONLY), observation_row with sha8 row_hash chain, ledger append. Only fixture lanes are wired to it

components.name: asolaria-events (graph-event producer)
components.role: Rust port of scoreEdgeRisk/buildGraphEvent that renders EVENT rows. No production crate depends on it; its rows reach l0_edge only in its own tests

components.name: live-parity
components.role: Offline check of the Rust L0/L4 against 3 responses recorded from the live :4792/:4793 on 2026-10-17 (sha-derived inputs, not graph events)

components.name: whiteroom-shannon l0_request
components.role: A second in-process L0 call (score_pair on sha-byte nodes) used by the whiteroom/fabric-thinker plane verdicts. No crate depends on whiteroom-shannon, so this path never reaches Hookwall

components.name: Vendored upstream scorer and server (not executed)
components.role: Pinned upstream bytes: the l0Infer :4792 query, the composite WEIGHTS (served copy has the L4 weight-0 edit), reverseGain, the HTTP server and the training label policy

components.name: host8 gnn-oracle (vendored)
components.role: A pixels-first byte/frame heuristic that shares the 'gnn-oracle' name with the :4792 service. It is not the trained L0. Its gnn_ready flag reflects cadence frames only

components.name: asolaria-gnn-int
components.role: Untrained, hand-set Q16 GCN reference. No crate depends on it and it is unrelated to L0

components.name: Runtime receipts (ACER)
components.role: What runs live: :4792 OFF and host8 gnn_ready=0 (2026-10-18). L0 spread/AUC on the w9_3 corpus. Served-vs-trained forward mismatch

hops.claim: The output is a Q24 sigmoid in 0..=2^24. It becomes e4 units (+toFixed(4)) as L0Reading/Signals.l0, then enters composite_e4 as a forward signal with weight 30/85 next to shannon 15 and baseline 10 (g1/g2/g3 are always None). The composite feeds reverse_gain, forward_score_q = composite/10 and reverse_risk_q = ceil((10000-composite)/10). Only the presence of the reading is passed to Fischer, as FischerScore.l0_real. If the actor or target was never observed, the output is None; the composite then renormalizes over shannon+baseline and l0_real becomes false.

traces.observe_only_mechanism: For L0 there is no observed, non-voting mode in aether. The only per-GNN 'report but do not vote' mechanism is leaving a signal out of composite_e4's weight list. Signals.l4 is documented as 'Reported, not weighted' (gate/observed/src/score.rs:44, weights 61-68), mirroring the owner's served-scorer edit (gate/observed/vendor/acer-scorer-2026-10-18/FABLE5-SCORER-L4-WEIGHT0-2026-10-18.diff:9-15). observe() always sets l4/g1/g2/g3 to None (gate/observed/src/lib.rs:79-82), so nothing is actually observed in a non-voting role today. Demoting L0 would mean editing score.rs:62. Even then, Fischer would still credit the reading's presence (l0_real: cpl -100, gnn_observable, center_gain +200; gate/fischer-eval/src/lib.rs:353-356, 404-407), because Fischer keys off presence, not value. A whole-gate OBSERVE_ONLY exists only in loop::hookwall (PassOpts.observe_only, decide_verdict loop/src/hookwall.rs:128-130), which sits on the unconnected GateLanes seam.
gaps: No real graph-event source reaches the L0 forward in aether. The NDJSON store is not ported, the asolaria-events producer is unused outside its tests, and observe runs only on caller-supplied HBP files. Every observe-path test uses the SYNTHETIC events.hbp or hand-built events.

The input is not consistent across contexts. Upstream live L0 is fed sha16(pid)/sha16(content) bytes (asolaria-score.mjs:112-114), aether's Hookwall path feeds graph-event features, and the checkpoint was trained on gnn-training-export-20260315 (receipt). No measurement shows L0 is informative on graph-event features from real traffic.

The direction is inverted. L0's training label 1 means suspicious (gnnDataExport.js:74-77), but the composite uses L0 as a forward/genius score, so suspicious histories are promoted to PROCEED and clean ones held (gate/observed/tests/e2e.rs:151-240). On the ACER corpus L0's AUC is below 0.5 (receipt GNN-REST:5,11,30).
L0 has no spread or 'calculates' gate. It fails std>0.01 on the ACER corpus (receipt) yet keeps weight 0.30, so it is the only voting GNN and it is unverified.

aether ports the served PyG forward, but the checkpoint was trained with the stub Linear GCNConv (receipt L1L2-RECHECK:8-9). The trained-vs-served difference (54,812 edges) is not represented or flagged in aether.

There are two disconnected Hookwall implementations: gate/verdict compose (reached by L0) and loop::hookwall pass/GateLanes (only fixture lanes, crate does not depend on l0-edge/observed). No adapter joins Observed to ScoreFields, and loop::hookwall::pass trusts sc.promoted without recomputing it from the composite.

There is no independent watcher of L0 output or verdicts. The observe path writes no ledger and no hashed row. The hash-chained hookwall_observation rows have no verifier in aether. The CLI GATE row is unhashed and unsigned.
The events file is unsigned and --sig covers only the envelope. `asolaria gate` accepts caller-supplied forward_score_q/reverse_risk_q/composite/l0_real, so L0 can be bypassed or forged.
Weight integrity is checked only in CI (parity/quantize/sha256). No runtime weight hash goes into the decision row.
A missing L0 reading renormalizes the composite rather than failing closed, and can raise it (ghost 6217 vs benign 2826).
Fischer credits L0's presence (l0_real), not its value or quality, so a degenerate L0 still loosens Fischer by 100 cpl.

No AND-upward verification across GNN levels and no human expansion gate tied to L0 was found on this path. L0 enters only through a weighted mean; the only AND-like step is gate/verdict strictest() over five non-GNN gates.

Live state (receipts): :4792 OFF and host8 gnn_ready=0 on 2026-10-18. Live parity covers only 3 captures recorded 2026-10-17. host8's gnn-oracle crate is a pixels-first byte heuristic that shares the name, not the trained L0.

traces.summary: L0 is the only GNN level that aether's Rust wires to a Hookwall verdict. The path is HBP EVENT rows -> l0_edge::observe_pair (integer Q24 port of the served EdgeLevelGNN with the checkpoint's own weights; within 6 Q24 units of torch and 1 unit of three live :4792 captures) -> e4 signal -> composite (weight 30/85) -> reverse gain -> forward_score_q/reverse_risk_q into spawn_gate (720/280), plus l0_real into Fischer -> asolaria_verdict::compose strictest -> `asolaria observe` exit code 0/3/4. Tests cover this path end to end (gate/observed/tests/e2e.rs, cli/tests/cli.rs), but only on SYNTHETIC or hand-built events. Nothing in aether connects the real graph-event source: the NDJSON store is not ported and the asolaria-events producer is used only in its own tests. Upstream live L0 is fed sha-hash bytes, not graph features. The loop/src/hookwall.rs GateLanes Hookwall is a seam with fixture lanes only and no link to L0. No independent watcher exists: the observe path writes no ledger and nothing verifies observation chains. No spread or 'calculates' gate exists, although receipts show L0 failing std>0.01 with AUC below 0.5 on the ACER corpus while still voting at 0.30. L0's direction is inverted: suspicious-labelled scores raise the forward score and promote to PROCEED. Tamper findings: unsigned events change the verdict while the signature still reads verified; a missing L0 renormalizes and can raise the composite; `asolaria gate` accepts forged scores and l0_real; a ledger write failure leaves FARM_GEM in place; loop::hookwall::pass trusts promoted without checking the composite. Fail-closed points: malformed events (exit 2), gate errors and an empty gate set (BLOCK), Fischer non-PROCEED (BLOCK_AND_PRESERVE), and lost output (never exit 0). Live receipts: :4792 OFF and host8 gnn_ready=0 on 2026-10-18; the host8 'gnn-oracle' crate is an unrelated byte heuristic. In the user's terms, L0 has the components and is wired into one of aether's two Hookwalls, but it is not independently verified, not gated on output quality, and not fed from the real source.

traces.summary:
L1 is disconnected. It is not attached anywhere as an observed, non-voting component, in aether's Rust or in the vendored upstream served code. Repo root: ..

What exists: model/l1-prototype is an integer-only Rust port of PrototypeGNN with its own run-1 trained weights (b4df9901, the same bytes as ACER's served prototype_model.pt). It matches the integer referee exactly and torch within tolerance (tests/model.rs:121-203), so model_exec is WIRED_TESTED. But no Cargo.toml in the repo depends on it, gate.yml has no CI job for it, and its only inputs are synthetic fixtures and random sweeps (input: FIXTURE_ONLY).

Output: a Q24 P(anomaly). It is ungated and constant in practice. Rust gives 16776797/2^24 on every fixture and every input below 2^54. The ACER receipt measured one constant, 0.9999749660491943 (= torch 0x3f7ffe5c), over all 315,249 corpus edges, AUC exactly 1/2. The only L1-shaped interface in aether is the hybrid harness Scorers.prototype closure: unconnected, a voting slot, and silently replaced by a sha256 pseudo-score when empty (output: SEAM).

No Hookwall component consumes L1. gate/observed Signals, the composite weights, gate/verdict VerifiedEnvelope and the loop hookwall ScoreFields all lack an L1 field. Upstream, asolaria-score.mjs never calls :4795, even though its comment claims L1/L2 still report in signals (hookwall_decision: ABSENT_IN_SCOPE). No watcher covers L1: live-parity covers L0/L4 only, host8 shows gnn_ready=0, and 4795 is not in host8's registry (watcher: ABSENT_IN_SCOPE). No action follows from it (action: ABSENT_IN_SCOPE).

Upstream, the ACER :4795 server reports a hard-coded checkpoint sha16 (0ffa2bfa) that no longer matches its file. With PyG installed, it also loads the stub-trained weights into a message-passing GCNConv; the difference is masked only by output saturation. The retrained, stratified L1 (dc8ea195, PyG keyform, passes std>0.01) is neither served (SWAP NOT_DONE) nor ported.

Tamper propagation: the only fail-closed behaviours are local to the crate (out-of-range node index returns Err) or cold-lane only (quantize.py refuses a checkpoint whose sha256, keys, shapes or module tree differ; not run in CI). Altered inputs, constant output, forged harness scores and stale checkpoint provenance all pass silently. Verdict-row, watcher and ledger tampering are not reachable, because L1 has no path to them.

The bench decision (count 0) therefore takes effect through absence, not through an observed, non-voting attachment. Making it the owner's intended observed, non-voting component would need an `l1: Option` signal in gate/observed (excluded from the composite), carried into the hashed observation row, plus an independent spread watcher and CI.

traces.summary:
L2 Contrastive GNN is a component that exists and is tested on its own, but it is not wired into Hookwall at any level, not even as an observed, non-voting component.

What exists: model/l2-contrastive is a real Rust integer port of ContrastiveGNN with its own run-1 weights (d371dbbf). It is parity-tested against upstream torch: within 1 Q24 unit on the anomaly probability and 8 on projections, over 262 synthetic edges, with the stub-vs-PyG layout pinned by a test. Status by hop:
- model_exec: WIRED_TESTED, though no CI job runs the crate.
- input: FIXTURE_ONLY. It takes caller Q24 features, builds none, and the real corpus in acer/ is never read by Rust.
- output: DOC_ONLY. The Q24 probability and 64-d projection are ungated; the std>0.01 spread gate exists only in receipts.

What is missing: hookwall_decision, watcher and action are all ABSENT_IN_SCOPE.
- No crate depends on asolaria-l2-contrastive.
- gate/observed Signals, the verdict's VerifiedEnvelope and loop/hookwall carry no L2. This contrasts with L4, which has a reported-zero-weight field that is itself never populated.
- The only 'contrastive' slot is the hybrid harness closure. It sits outside Hookwall, has no caller, and silently falls back to a sha256 stub.
- Upstream is the same: the served scorer has no l1/l2 key despite its 'same as L1/L2' comment, and there is no L2 server; the planned :4796 is now recall-serve-rust.

Live receipts: L2 as trained has AUC 0.5218, std 1.46e-05 and 12 unique values, so the gate fails. The stratified retrain passes (std 0.0119), but it is not swapped in, and the Rust port's quantizer refuses it (PyG keyform). GNN servers are OFF and host8 gnn_ready=0.

Tamper and failure behaviour: inside the crate, out-of-range indices fail closed and NaN is unrepresentable. Altered features, corrupted weights (no CI), constant output, forged or out-of-range scores in the harness seam, and stub substitution all pass silently. Every upward propagation path is unreachable, because nothing above the model consumes L2.

traces.summary: L3 (HRM/MTP) is not part of the Hookwall in aether. What exists is a parity-tested Rust integer port (model/hrm-mtp) of two things: the bigpickle HRM deterministic stub plus the MTP zeta heads and preWarm, and the universe simulator's rime HRM and MTP agents. The rime agents are count tables frozen from input bytes at run time. Both run in-process and match upstream JS and Python on fixture and synthetic inputs (WIRED_TESTED for model execution); their enwik8/enwik9 parity is a MEASURED receipt only. No Hookwall component consumes any HRM/MTP output. GateLanes offers only score() and fischer(); FischerScore, ScoreFields, VerifiedEnvelope and GATE_NAMES have no L3 field; and no gate, loop, cli or host8 crate depends on asolaria-hrm-mtp. The only dependents are agents/levels, which prints text whose 'GATE:' lines are literals, and whiteroom-shannon, which uses Hilbert (Layer 1) only. So L3 is not even connected as an observed, non-voting component. The Fischer lane it would route through is itself a seam that only fixtures implement. MTP preWarm's speculative PIDs reach no action, because the loop uses a second, duplicate revolver without preWarm. There is no output gate, no runtime watcher and no ledger action. The only independent observer is the cold-lane Python referees, through committed fixtures, and no CI job runs them or the crate's tests. No trained HRM checkpoint exists in aether: model/hrm-fork carries only Sapient's Python code (cold, not importable) plus hp_mix, which is not HRM, and the ACER handoff lists the owner's HRM checkpoint as not on ACER. Upstream HRM-to-hookwall wiring (Falcon /api/hrm) is cited, not vendored. Tamper results: short input panics instead of failing closed; altered input, constant output and literal GATE lines all pass silently; domain and trig boundaries fail closed with JsError::Domain; the windunwind exact=0 case yields a detection row only.

traces.summary: No nested or recursive (L5+) GNN level is integrated into Hookwall in aether, and no trained one exists. Five L5+-shaped pieces exist as standalone Rust libraries: the G4 GLSM transition, which is the only recursive G-level because it consumes G1/G2/G3; the G1/G2 leaves; the G3 sign flip; a hybrid 5-scorer harness over omni, reverse, gsl, contrastive and prototype; and an L0+L4 mean ensemble. All are tested only against synthetic or fixture rows (CI does not run them), and nothing feeds them real lower-level outputs. The actual recursion, G1->G2->G3 feeding G4, exists only in vendored quant-bus.mjs, and its plane modules are absent from aether. Hookwall has typed seams for these outputs, and the G4 consumer is tested fail-closed: unknown states block, lowering states cannot loosen, and MISTAKE_FLAGGED is a hard BLOCK. But gate/observed hard-codes g1..g3=None and g4_state=UNKNOWN, CLI gate mode accepts these values as caller text, and no Cargo dependency connects any L5+ crate to gate/*, loop or cli. Failure handling is mostly silent: NaN or missing inputs freeze G4, an absent scorer is replaced by a sha stub that still votes, a constant output votes with no spread gate, and an unreachable L4 halves the ensemble while still reporting it real. An unset mask path defaults to the demo set. The only contract mismatch, the DESCRIBED/\"\" G4 states, would fail closed by blocking everything. The independent watcher (N-Nest: separate process, parent recompute, AND-upward) runs in CI only as Python/Node over synthetic Q-PRISM leaves. The outer watcher is doc-only. ACER receipts show the live G path absent (:4949 returns 404), the GNN servers OFF and host8 gnn_ready=0. GNN predictions there auto-dispatch through an unported Node bridge outside aether's Hookwall.

components.name: gate/hookwall (asolaria-hookwall)
components.role: Extract of FED kernel-core with comment-only edits, except crypto, which is real Ed25519 (verify_strict). hookwall_pre: slot<64, then by tier only (Micro=PROCEED, Cosign=HOLD, Firmware=BLOCK). hookwall_post: hashes a 16-byte HVD row into an in-memory counter. spawn_gate: strictest-wins order is deny tags, then tier, then forward>=720 and risk<=280. tier_gate: 7x7 matrix. sign_gate: Ed25519 plus an unscoped VIRUS rescue. cosign_chain: in memory only, nothing persists.

components.name: gate/verdict compose
components.role: Layer-5 tighten-only composition. Runs hookwall, spawn_gate, tier_gate, Fischer (gate/fischer-eval) and input_guard over one VerifiedEnvelope. Severity is max(Proceed<Hold<Block), and an empty set gives Block. The only multi-gate AND in aether's Rust. It acts on nothing and persists nothing.

components.name: gate/observed
components.role: The only real GNN-to-Hookwall call path. EVENT rows go to l0_edge::observe_pair (L0 Q24). That feeds the asolaria-score signals and composite, then reverse gain, then forward_score_q/reverse_risk_q (spawn gate) and l0_real/shannon (Fischer), then compose. The l4, g1, g2 and g3 slots are always None, and g4_state is hard-coded UNKNOWN.
